decisions.reason: This air fin cooler sits close to the core offer and costs little to keep listed, and one year of market presence has not yet resolved its uncertain value, so the option is worth holding.
The single-tube condenser is still early in its market test and cheap to carry, though it may overlap with Product C and so faces some risk of consolidation.
It is a near-duplicate of Product B, which adds some chance that the two condensers are merged, but there is no evidence yet that its value cannot be realized.
This tube liner extends the firm's lifecycle service business at low carrying cost, and its value is still unfolding, so keeping the option is justified.
This customized cooler line with several models is central to the firm's integrated-solutions strategy, and dropping it early would forfeit a broad option.
These repair inserts support the firm's aftermarket service at minimal cost, with uncertainty still unresolved after a 2023 launch.
